families.notes: Two identical copies. x viewed as (-1,N), one program per row, BLOCK=next_pow2(N); max/exp/sum done in input dtype (no fp32 upcast), output dtype=input. test_softmax.py imports a non-existent module and its 3D test compares torch.softmax(dim=1) with the kernel's last-dim softmax (test bug).

families.reference: torch.autograd.grad(torch.softmax(x,-1), x, dy)  == p*(dy - (p*dy).sum(-1,keepdim=True)), p=saved softmax output

Flat contiguous tensors of equal numel. Wrapper bug: a.is_cuda() called as a method -> TypeError before launch. num_elems is constexpr (recompile per size).

families.notes: Autotuned (num_warps). fp32 compute, y cast to x.dtype; also writes rstd=1/sqrt(mean(x^2)+eps) per row (fp32). Bwd: per-SM fp32 dW partials [sm_count,N] summed in torch then cast to weight.dtype. Requires N <= 65536/elem_size. No bias, no residual. No in-repo test. A third bwd kernel exists only inside a docstring (not counted).

open_decisions: group = 128 contiguous elements along last dim (1x128 tiles), last dim must divide by block_size
scale = max(amax, 1e-12)/448 (e4m3fn max) stored fp32 per group; dequant x ~= q*scale
q = clamp(x/scale, -448, 448) cast to float8_e4m3fn (Triton fp32->fp8 rounding mode, RNE assumed); division done in fp32
tolerance at fp8 rounding boundaries when reference divides in float64
spec_sources: DeepSeek-V3 technical report §3.3 (1x128 tile-wise FP8 activation quantisation)
FBGEMM quantize_fp8_block / torchao float8 blockwise quant
families.notes: Outputs float8_e4m3fn (Triton fp8e4nv needs sm89+). Only stride(-1)==1 is checked but indexing assumes fully contiguous x (bug for other strides). Wrapper prints scales.size(). Candidate ref: s=x.view(...,-1,128).abs().amax(-1).clamp_min(1e-12)/448; q=(x/s).clamp(-448,448).to(float8_e4m3fn).

families.reference: (scale_a*scale_b*torch.mm(a.double(), b.double())).half()  # a:[M,K], b:[K,N]; scale_a=scale_b=1 for gemm_split_k_kernel
families.notes: Dtype-generic tl.dot code intended for fp8 inputs: float8_e4m3fn operands need sm89+ in Triton, so on A6000 run with fp16/bf16 (or e5m2) operands. Per-tensor python-float scales multiplied after fp32 accumulation. split_k fp32 partials tl.atomic_add'ed into zero-init fp16 C (order nondeterministic, fp16 rounding per add); 'acc.to(tl.float16)' result discarded. Loads are masked on K only: rows/cols beyond M/N read out of bounds (stores masked).
Hopper-only: host fill_2d_tma_descriptor + tl._experimental_descriptor_load/store, fp8e4nv operands. Fixed 64x64x256 tiles (config argument ignored). fp32 accumulate, fp16 output.

families.reference: (torch.mm(a.double(), b.double().T) * a_scale.double()[:,None] * b_scale.double()[None,:]).to(c.dtype)  # a:[M,K], b:[N,K] fp8 e4m3fn, a_scale:[M], b_scale:[N]
families.notes: Persistent, TMA descriptors for A/B/C and 1-D scale descriptors; fp8e4nv. Kernel multiplies by scales (scales are dequant/'reciprocal' scales: A*A_scale = original A) although matmul_fp8_row docstring says a@b/(a_scale*b_scale). prep_matmul and the non-TMA kernel are missing from the repo (non-TMA path returns None); output dtype comes from missing prep_matmul (bf16 in FBGEMM). dot_out_dtype accumulator; fp8_fast_accum/allow_tf32 unused.

open_decisions: qweight int32 [K/8,N]: 8 int4 per word packed along K, element k at bits 4*(k%8) (LSB first)
qzeros int32 [K/G,N/8] packed along N with same nibble order; stored zero is z-1 (dequant uses z+1, AutoGPTQ legacy convention)
scales [K/G,N] fp16, group = k // groupsize, groupsize hardcoded 128, no act-order/g_idx permutation
dequant w = q*s - (z+1)*s evaluated in fp16 (intermediate rounding) vs exact (q-z-1)*s
fp16 activations, fp32 accumulate, fp16 output; split-K partials atomically added in fp16
families.notes: Bugs: a100/h100 (block_k=256) and small_benchmark split-K (block_k*split_k=512) compute g_id = k // (groupsize // block_k) with groupsize=128 -> integer division by zero; only splitk_dequant_gemm (block_k=128=groupsize) and matmul_data_parallel_kernel (block_k=64) index groups consistently. h100 store mask compares rows with n instead of m; no load masks anywhere (M,N,K must be tile multiples; a100/data-parallel wrap offsets with %m/%n but store unmasked). h100 fp8_fast_accum branch (tl.float, fp8e4nv) is dead (constexpr False). No in-repo correctness test.

families.notes: Needs vllm._C. Bugs: output stored at sorted position offs_m (not offs_token) without mask -> wrong/out-of-bounds scatter; invoke_dequant_gemm_moe overrides topk=2 so the second GEMM (needs top_k=1) reads wrong rows; K loop bound uses packed dim. Treat as unfinished prototype.

families.notes: Precondition: sorted_token_ids/expert_ids/num_tokens_post_padded produced from topk_ids by vLLM ops.moe_align_block_size (external CUDA op); padded slots (id==numel) masked. fp16/bf16 inputs, fp32 acc, routed weight applied in fp32 before cast. v1 split-K tl.atomic_add's compute_type partials into zeroed C (fp16 fine on sm86; bf16 atomics may need sm90). v2 col_major mapping (pid_m = pid % grid_n, pid_n = pid // grid_m) is wrong unless grid_m==grid_n -> tiles skipped/duplicated. test imports a missing splitk_moe_fused module.

families.notes: Single-query decode, caches [num_blocks,H,D,block_size] for both K and V (not vLLM's x-split key layout); num_kv_heads must equal num_heads (no GQA). MAX_SEQ_LEN, HEAD_SIZE powers of 2. Debug static_print calls.

families.reference: F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=causal, scale=sm_scale)  # flash custom op: causal=True, sm_scale=d**-0.5; attention(): causal=False; aux M = torch.logsumexp(sm_scale*q@k^T, -1)/ln2
families.notes: Causal mask is bottom-right aligned when seqlen_q != seqlen_k (SDPA is_causal is top-left) -> compare with equal lengths or explicit mask. Head dims padded to {32,64,128,256}; fully-masked rows -> 0 output, LSE=+inf. Constexpr paths not wired by wrappers and not covered by the reference: VARLEN cu_seqlens, additive bias, ALiBi (-slope*|i+sk-j-sq|), GQA with off_h_k = off_h_q % hk (differs from SDPA enable_gqa grouping), dropout (path references undefined off_hz, does not compile).

families.notes: Always causal (consistent with flash(causal=True), not with non-causal attention()). P and dS hardcoded .to(bfloat16) -> only bf16 inputs compile (fp16 gives dot dtype mismatch; __main__ uses fp16). Needs N_CTX % 128 == 0, seqlen_q==seqlen_k, hq==hk, identical contiguous strides; uses log2-domain LSE from fwd with k pre-scaled by sm_scale/ln2. ALiBi path calls undefined compute_alibi_block (disabled).
